intro.title: useMediaQuery
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Angular component that dynamically changes its text and style based on the screen width. You will learn how to use the `useMediaQuery` function from Angular CDK to detect and respond to changes in viewport size. The main technologies involved are Angular components, TypeScript, and reactive programming with observables. By the end, you will understand how to make your applications responsive and adaptive to different devices.
intro.usecase: The useMediaQuery pattern is essential for creating responsive applications that adapt to different screen sizes and device capabilities. In real-world Angular applications, developers use this to conditionally render dashboard components on large screens while showing simplified mobile views, adjust form layouts between desktop and tablet modes, and toggle navigation menus between full sidebar and hamburger menu styles. Product examples include e-commerce sites that rearrange product grids, analytics dashboards that show/hide detailed panels, and media players that switch control layouts based on available space. This pattern allows developers to build single codebases that deliver optimal user experiences across all devices.
